entries.title: The Life Between Diagnoses
entries.description: On being one in a million, losing medical school to an illness I barely understood, and spending fifteen years learning more about eosinophils than I ever intended.
entries.summary: A firsthand account of attacks, interrupted schooling, the medical-school path that was lost, and the uneasy distance between a laboratory count and what a patient experiences.

entries.title: Sorry, My First Email to You Was Probably Polished by AI
entries.description: On the strange etiquette of strangers, the industrialization of professional language, and the curious prestige of detecting the obvious.
entries.summary: A pointed essay about what recipients think they learn by accusing unfamiliar writers of using AI, and whose language is subjected to that scrutiny.

entries.title: We Taught People to Sound Like Machines. Now We’re Surprised They Use Them.
entries.description: On the industrialization of human expression, academic conformity, and our sudden nostalgia for originality in the age of artificial intelligence.
entries.summary: Why the standardized prose institutions taught us to produce now looks suspiciously like the output of the machines they condemn.

entries.title: Fifteen Things I Wish Young Academics Were Told About Mental Health
entries.description: On the peculiar psychology of academic ambition, the things we sacrifice in pursuit of knowledge, and why becoming a good scientist should never require becoming a miserable human being.
entries.summary: Notes on institutional expectations, ambition, and psychological wellbeing in a profession that prides itself on questioning assumptions.

entries.title: The Nobel Prize Has Room for Three. Science Never Did.
entries.description: On the 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine, the forgotten experiments behind optogenetics, and the peculiar way scientific history decides whom to remember.
entries.summary: A historical argument about how scientific discoveries accumulate through many hands while awards preserve a much shorter list of names.
